QuestInfo.0: What Tru shows you is...the #bSeal Stone of Victoria Island#k? Talk to #b#p1002104##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p1002104# says that ever since he got ambushed by the #o9300346#s, he's been using any means necessary to find the Seal Stone. He feels that holding on to the Seal Stone would be dangerous, so he wants to store it in #b#m140000000##k, the deserted island. I'd better deliver the #bSeal Stone to #p1201000##k. But who could be the #bowner of the client#k that Tru is talking about?
QuestInfo.2: You didn't learn what the #t4032323# was for, but it seemed the Black Wings were after it.

default.0: You still haven't gone to see #b#p1201000##k yet? Don't worry, don't worry. Even most information dealers don't know much about #m140000000# Island. #b#m140000000##k is the safest spot. Trust me on this and let #p1201000# handle the Seal Stone.
